answer: Idle broker bots reserved paid core-sample windows at the east quartz adit of Pit M-14 and never showed. To keep a window, a claimant must carry the 5.6 kg echo hammer from cage C-3, walk 41 m of wet track to the basalt face mark B-7, and strike a 12-second ringing count on pin 4-08 before the 03:26 shift bell. Mass must stay within 60 g of 5.6 kg, the walk 40-70 s, and the ringing log must match the cage tag. A 175-chip bond is taken even on a refuse. A late log, a reused tag, or a hammer that never leaves cage C-3 voids the window for 6 shifts.
